name: social_post_listing
title: Social Post Listing
description: Feed of social posts (data_items_social_post.json), newest first: author avatar + name + date, the text (Show More / Show Less over 300 characters, links clickable), images (1-4 in a grid, opened in the popup gallery) or a video from data_items_video.json, and link buttons. With "index": true a narrow sticky anchor_index of the posts sits next to the feed for jumping to a post.
